Frequently asked questions

Which restaurants accept EBT in Bronx?

Bronx has 66 restaurants authorized for the SNAP Restaurant Meals Program, including McDonald's, Popeyes, Dunkin', KFC. Each accepts EBT from eligible recipients for prepared meals.

Can anyone use EBT at these Bronx restaurants?

No — only recipients enrolled in the Restaurant Meals Program: those who are 60 or older, have a disability, or are experiencing homelessness (and their spouses). New York is a participating state.

What can I buy with EBT at a restaurant in Bronx?

Hot and ready-to-eat meals. Alcohol, tobacco and non-food items aren't covered, and most states don't allow EBT to pay tips. It draws from your regular SNAP balance.

We never collect personal information and cannot enroll you in SNAP.
